text:
Predicates:
Pet(x) ::: x is a pet.
Allowed(x, y) ::: x is allowed in y.
ManagedBuilding(x) ::: x is a managed building.
DepositRequired(x) ::: a deposit is required to rent an apartment in x.
SecurityDeposit(x, y) ::: the security deposit for x is y.
EqualOrMore(x, y) ::: x is equal to or more than y.
Cat(x) ::: x is a cat.
Owner(x, y) ::: x owns y.
MonthlyRent(x, y) ::: the monthly rent at x is y.
RentApartment(x, y) ::: x will rent an apartment in y.
MoveInWith(x, y) ::: x is allowed to move in with y.
MoreThan(x, y) ::: x is more than y.

Premises:
∃x ∃y (ManagedBuilding(y) ∧ Pet(x) ∧ Allowed(x, y)) ::: Pets are allowed in some managed buildings.
∀x (ManagedBuilding(x) → DepositRequired(x)) ::: A deposit is required to rent an apartment in a managed building.
∀x (DepositRequired(x) → ∃y (SecurityDeposit(x, y) ∧ EqualOrMore(y, "one_months_rent"))) ::: The security deposit can be either equal to one month's rent or more.
Cat(fluffy) ::: Fluffy is Tom's cat.
Owner(tom, fluffy) ::: Tom owns Fluffy.
∀x (Cat(x) → Pet(x)) ::: Cats are pets.
ManagedBuilding(oliveGarden) ::: The Olive Garden is a managed building.
MonthlyRent(oliveGarden, 2000) ::: The monthly rent at the Olive Garden is $2000.
RentApartment(tom, x) ↔ (MoveInWith(tom, fluffy) ∧ ∃y (SecurityDeposit(x, y) ∧ ¬MoreThan(y, 1500))) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in a managed building if and only if he is allowed to move in with Fluffy, and the security deposit is no more than $1500.
MoreThan(2000, 1500) ::: 2000$ is more than $1500.

Conclusion:
RentApartment(tom, oliveGarden) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in The Olive Garden.
